queries: select "id", "teaching_group_id", "offering_id" from "teaching_group_offerings" where "teaching_group_offerings"."teaching_group_id" in (select "id" from "teaching_groups" where "teaching_groups"."term_id" = $1)

select "id", "teaching_group_id", "expected_weekly_minutes", "required_meetings_per_week", "status", "notes" from "teaching_requirements" where "teaching_requirements"."teaching_group_id" in (select "id" from "teaching_groups" where "teaching_groups"."term_id" = $1)

select "id", "teaching_group_id", "day_of_week", "start_minutes", "end_minutes", "effective_from", "effective_to", "is_exception", "exception_note", "custom_time_label", "highlight_color", "status", "created_at" from "meetings" where "meetings"."teaching_group_id" in (select "id" from "teaching_groups" where "teaching_groups"."term_id" = $1)

select "id", "meeting_id", "teacher_id", "role" from "meeting_teachers" where "meeting_teachers"."meeting_id" in (select "id" from "meetings" where "meetings"."teaching_group_id" in (select "id" from "teaching_groups" where "teaching_groups"."term_id" = $1))

select "id", "meeting_id", "room_id", "room_role" from "meeting_rooms" where "meeting_rooms"."meeting_id" in (select "id" from "meetings" where "meetings"."teaching_group_id" in (select "id" from "teaching_groups" where "teaching_groups"."term_id" = $1))

select "id", "term_id", "batch_id", "stream", "day_of_week", "start_minutes", "end_minutes", "requires_exception_note" from "permitted_windows" where ("permitted_windows"."term_id" = $1 or "permitted_windows"."term_id" is null)
